outdir.description: Output directory where results will be saved. Required. work/.nextflow/results will be subfolder under this directory. Will be created if absent. Nextflow will resume if present.

input.description: Path to comma-separated sample information CSV file with columns sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,replicate. Required. For example: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/test-datasets/atacseq/samplesheet/v2.0/samplesheet_test.csv

host.description: Host genome reference fasta file path. Required. hg38 or mm39

viruses.description: Comma-separated list of viral genomes to include in alignment. Options: NC_007605.1,NC_006273.2,NC_001664.4,NC_000898.1,NC_001716.2,NC_009333.1,NC_045512.2,MN485971.1,NC_001806.2,KT899744.1,MH636806.1,KT899744delRR Default: null (no viral genomes).

fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA file path. Can be provided if available else will be created using host + viruses.

gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF file path. Can be provided if available else will be created using host + viruses

fragment_size.description: Estimated fragment size used to extend single-end reads.

fingerprint_bins.description: Number of genomic bins used in fingerprint QC plots.

read_length.description: Read length for genome size calculations and peak calling.

with_control.description: Indicates if controls are specified in the samplesheet.

skip_trimming.description: Skip adapter trimming step if input reads are already trimmed.

save_trimmed.description: Save trimmed FastQ files to output directory.

min_trimmed_reads.description: Minimum trimmed reads threshold below which samples are discarded.

aligner.description: Aligner program to use (bwa, bowtie2, chromap, star).

bwa_min_score.description: Minimum BWA MEM alignment score for saving an alignment.

keep_mito.description: Keep mitochondrial reads instead of filtering them out.

keep_dups.description: Do not filter duplicate reads from alignments.

keep_multi_map.description: Allow multi-mapped reads to be retained.

skip_merge_replicates.description: Skip merging replicates in downstream analysis.

save_align_intermeds.description: Save intermediate BAM files from alignment step.

broad_cutoff.description: Broad peak cutoff value for MACS2 peak calling.

macs_fdr.description: FDR cutoff for peak detection in MACS2.

macs_pvalue.description: P-value cutoff for peak detection in MACS2.

min_reps_consensus.description: Minimum replicates to support consensus peak.

save_macs_pileup.description: Save bedGraph files normalized by signal per million reads.

skip_consensus_peaks.description: Skip consensus peak generation and counting.

deseq2_vst.description: Use variance stabilizing transformation for DESeq2 instead of rlog.

skip_deseq2_qc.description: Skip DESeq2 PCA and heatmap plots.

skip_qc.description: Skip all QC steps except MultiQC.

mito_name.description: Mitochondrial chromosome name in the reference genome.
